answer: Make proof-of-work difficulty ADAPTIVE to correlated throughput. Each minting stamp must clear a difficulty that rises with the aggregate submission rate attributable to its source — timing and origin correlation whispered across the batch. One honest agent at a steady jetty-side pace clears an easy target; an operator firing a thousand fakes in parallel drives its own correlated rate up, so each stamp hardens like crystal under pressure and per-identity cost climbs super-linearly with fleet size. It raises the price of breadth rather than claiming to make it impossible.
